title: U of T researchers demonstrate AI worm could target any online device
summary: University of Toronto researchers demonstrated an AI-powered worm capable of targeting any online device, raising significant concerns about emerging AI-driven cybersecurity threats similar to the historic Morris Worm but with enhanced autonomous capabilities.
problem_solved: This research doesn't solve a problem—it exposes a new class of AI-powered cyber threats that could autonomously propagate through interconnected systems.
why_valuable: By demonstrating AI worms before malicious actors do, researchers enable the security community to develop defenses and raise awareness about next-generation cyber threats.
